before: yes when a source ties this pipeline, segment, or expansion to LNG export: it delivers gas into an LNG export terminal, carries feedgas toward one (including upstream supply lines), or has an LNG exporter as a named shipper or reason for the project. Export terminals in Mexico that take US gas count. Blank otherwise, never no. A pipeline tied only to an import terminal stays blank and names the terminal in AssociatedLNGTerminal.
after: export when a source ties this pipeline, segment, or expansion to LNG export: it delivers gas into an LNG export terminal, carries feedgas toward one (including upstream supply lines), or has an LNG exporter as a named shipper or reason for the project. import when the tie is only to an LNG import terminal. A line tied to both is export. Terminals outside the US, such as those in Mexico and Canada, count. Blank otherwise, never no. The terminal name goes in AssociatedLNGTerminal.
